$comment: Generated from packages/shared/src/session-tools.ts by `npm run generate:session-tools-contract -w @open-inspect/shared`. Do not edit.

tools.name: notify_user
tools.description: Send the session's owner a short direct message. Use it when you are blocked on a decision only they can make, or when a long task reaches a result they are waiting for; never for progress chatter. The server picks the recipient and channel; you cannot address anyone. Never include secrets, credentials, customer names or client data: the message can appear on a phone lock screen. At most 5 messages per session and 1 per minute.

message.description: What the owner needs to know, in one or two plain sentences. Mentions and links other than this deployment's and GitHub's are removed.

urgency.description: Use high only when you are blocked until the owner acts.

tools.name: motion_get_task
tools.description: Read the motion Task this session was delegated from: its title, description, status, priority, due date, project, labels and subtasks. Available only in sessions motion started.

tools.name: motion_add_note
tools.description: Attach a note to the motion Task this session was delegated from, for example a summary of findings or a link to the pull request. It cannot change the Task's status; motion settles the Task when the session ends. Never include secrets or credentials.

title.description: A short title for the note.

content.description: The note body, plain text or Markdown.

tools.name: repo_context
tools.description: Read who owns this session's repository and how careful to be with it: the owner team, the tier (T1 is the most critical, T3 the least), the class (playground, internal or client; an unclassified repository counts as client), its domain and dependencies, and the owners its CODEOWNERS file names. Use it before deciding whom a change affects or how much review it needs.
